updates.upToDateCopy: This installation is running {version}. No newer version is available in the selected release channel. Your local models and settings are unchanged.
updates.desktopCopy: The complete desktop update ({version}) is available. The desktop shell will verify the official Windows setup installer against GitHub’s SHA-256 digest, create a full application backup, update the shell and runtime together, and check local health before keeping the update. Settings, engines, models and logs remain in your user-data folder.
updates.desktopMissing: A newer release ({version}) is available, but its Windows desktop installer is not attached yet. The current installation will not be changed.
updates.applyDesktop: After verification, choose Apply update & restart. The previous files are kept for rollback.
updates.applyWindowsArchive: This installation cannot safely replace itself in place. Use the release download to extract the verified package into a new application folder, then start it there. Your settings, engines and models remain in the separate user-data folder.
updates.applyManualArchive: This platform verifies the official package in the app but does not yet install it in place. Close the app, extract the new archive into a new folder, and start it again; settings, engines and models remain in your user-data folder.
updates.unsupportedPackage: You are using {current}. A newer release exists, but the official release metadata does not include a supported package and SHA-256 digest for this computer. Open the release notes to download manually; automatic staging is disabled.
updates.unavailableBackground: Could not check for updates · local app remains available
updates.failedCopy: Local AI Runtime is still available. Check your internet connection or open GitHub Releases to check the current version manually.
updates.checkFailed: Update check failed · local app remains available
updates.staged: Verified package {version} is staged ({size}). Its size and SHA-256 were checked again on this device. Your running application, settings, engines and models have not been changed.
updates.awaitingHealth: Application files were replaced and the new runtime is being checked. If the update helper stops unexpectedly, the launcher will restore the verified backup before starting the app.
updates.applyingCopy: The update helper is applying the verified package. The runtime will restart; keep this folder and the user-data folder in place. If the operation is interrupted, the launcher will attempt verified backup recovery.
updates.rollbackFailed: Automatic rollback failed. Check the local update log before attempting another update.
updates.applyUnsupported: Apply-and-restart is not supported by this installation. The verified package is kept staged and no files were changed.
updates.desktopShellHint: The secure in-app installer is available in the Windows desktop shell. Use the Local AI Runtime notification-area icon and choose “Check for updates”.
updates.requestPackage: Requesting the official platform package. No running files will be changed.
updates.verifiedReadyCopy: The {version} package was downloaded and its SHA-256 digest matched GitHub release metadata. It is staged in the Local AI Runtime user-data folder. Nothing has been changed.
updates.downloadFailedCopy: {detail} Your current installation and user data are unchanged.
updates.applyStarting: The update helper is verifying the staged package once more, preparing a backup, and will restart the runtime. The dashboard may briefly disconnect.
updates.applyAccepted: Update accepted. Waiting for the runtime to stop and return. The page will reload when the apply result is available.
updates.applyCouldNotCopy: {detail} The verified package remains staged; no update is reported as successful unless the restarted runtime passes its health check.
updates.takingLong: Update status for {version} is taking longer than expected
updates.takingLongCopy: The runtime has not returned to a verifiable state yet. Do not delete the rollback folder. Inspect %LOCALAPPDATA%/LocalAIRuntime/logs/update-apply.log and apply-status.json before retrying.

updates.confirmApply:
Apply {version} and restart Local AI Runtime?

The current runtime and managed AI engines will stop briefly. User settings, downloaded engines and model files are stored separately and will not be replaced. A backup will be kept for rollback. Do not close this folder or shut down the computer during the update.
models.recoveryHint: The model is already downloaded and verified. Close any app that may be using the model file, confirm the license again, then retry finalization without downloading it again.
engine.gpuEvidenceDisclaimer: This confirms that the engine reported layer offload at startup. It does not measure live GPU utilization during inference.
engine.gpuEvidenceMissing: GPU execution has not been verified from the current engine log.

device.currentProfileCpu: Current Chat engine is configured for CPU
device.glanceNote: OS adapter inventory and NVIDIA driver identity, live GPU readings, and proof of model offload are separate checks.
models.recommendationDescription: Curated against a 6 GB GPU / 16 GB RAM reference profile. Real compatibility still depends on your device, context, backend and a successful local inference test.
models.noRecommendations: No reviewed chat models are available for this device yet.
activity.gpuBackendCpu: Your current Chat engine requests CPU execution. Missing live GPU telemetry does not prevent a later CUDA test.
activity.gpuBackendOffloadReported: The engine log reports GPU offloaded layers; live readings remain a separate system-wide signal.
activity.gpuBackendNotVerified: CUDA/GPU layers are requested, but actual offload has not yet been confirmed by the engine log.
activity.gpuBackendNotConfigured: No configured Chat backend is available to test GPU execution.
catalog.qwen3-4b-q4km.description: Balanced general-purpose local chat candidate for a 6 GB laptop GPU and 16 GB system RAM. Official Qwen GGUF weights with multilingual, reasoning and coding strengths. Begin at 4,096 context; GPU offload has not yet been validated on this device.
catalog.qwen3-4b-q4km.limits: The 2.50 GB model file is not the full inference-memory requirement; KV cache and runtime memory are additional. Start at 2,048–4,096 context on a 6 GB laptop GPU. CUDA package installation and GPU detection do not prove inference offload.
catalog.gemma4-e2b-q4.description: Alternative compact chat model using Google’s official QAT GGUF weights. This catalogue entry enables text chat only; vision and audio are not enabled in Local AI Runtime. Begin at 2,048 context on a 6 GB laptop GPU.
catalog.gemma4-e2b-q4.limits: The model file is about 3.12 GiB; runtime memory and context cache are additional. Full GPU offload has not been validated on this device. Only text chat is enabled; vision and audio support are not implied.
catalog.qwen2.5-1.5b-q4km.description: Lightweight fallback chat model for low-memory systems and CPU-first setup. The model file is about 1.04 GiB; active context and runtime overhead use additional memory.
catalog.qwen2.5-1.5b-q4km.limits: Model fit depends on context and runtime overhead. CUDA compatibility and GPU placement must be tested on the target machine.
catalog.llama.cpp-cpu.description: Installs the latest compatible official llama.cpp CPU server build. The installer verifies the official release digest, safely extracts the archive and registers the local engine.
catalog.llama.cpp-cuda12.description: Installs the official llama.cpp CUDA 12 server and its matching runtime libraries from the same release. Both archives are SHA-256 verified before activation.
catalog.llama.cpp-cuda13.description: Installs the official llama.cpp CUDA 13 server and its matching runtime libraries from the same release. Both archives are SHA-256 verified before activation.
hardware.profileLowMemory: This device has limited system memory. Start with a small quantized model and a short context; close other applications before loading it.
hardware.profileBaseline: This is a baseline memory profile. Start with a compact model; available RAM, context length and GPU memory determine what fits.
hardware.profileMemoryHeadroom: System memory headroom is available, but it does not guarantee that a model fits. Check model size, context and GPU memory.
hardware.profileUnknown: System memory could not be measured. Begin with a small quantized model and verify it with a real local request.
hardware.cpuReasonRecommended: The lightweight starter model is the safest first test in this catalogue. Its weight file is about 1.12 GB; runtime memory grows with context and other applications.
hardware.cpuReasonCaution: The starter model may work, but memory headroom is limited. Keep the context short and close other applications before loading it.
hardware.cpuReasonConstrained: Available memory is tight. Reduce context, close other applications, or free memory before attempting the starter model.
hardware.cpuReasonDisk: There is not enough free model-storage space for a safe download and extraction. Free disk space first.
hardware.cpuReasonUnknown: The system could not confirm enough resource information. Review free disk space and available RAM before installing a model.
hardware.gpuReasonCandidate: An NVIDIA GPU with at least 4 GiB dedicated memory was detected. This is only a candidate: install a CUDA engine and verify a real inference request and engine offload logs.
hardware.gpuReasonReview: An NVIDIA GPU was detected, but reported dedicated memory is below the screening threshold or unavailable. Try only after checking the model size, context and driver.
hardware.gpuReasonNotDetected: No NVIDIA adapter was found in the operating-system inventory. The CPU option remains the supported starting point in this catalogue.
hardware.gpuReasonUnknown: The graphics inventory is incomplete. GPU compatibility cannot be assessed; use the CPU path until the device can be checked.
